articles.title: RBI eases forex rules for services exports and imports
articles.desc: The changes form part of the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) which came into effect from October 1, 2026. Under the amended regulations, a resident individual exporting services will be deemed to have submitted the Export Declaration Form, or EDF, once the individual provides the authorised dealer bank with the information required to credit the payment to the exporter's account. No transaction-value threshold has been prescribed for resident individuals.

articles.desc: Yemeni interior minister says foreign involvement expanded beyond arms and training to directing military operations.

articles.title: Taco Bell sales fall more than expected on cyclosporiasis outbreak hit
articles.desc: Yum Brands faced a setback in the third quarter as Taco Bell reported declining sales, primarily due to a cyclosporiasis outbreak that sparked customer concerns. While the outbreak severely impacted customer traffic, there was a notable recovery in sales during September and October. Although same-store sales remained flat, falling short of analysts' predictions, the company surpassed profit expectations, boosting investor trust in Yum Brands.

articles.title: Festive season: Pistachio prices nearly double, almonds up 20% on West Asia crisis and US crop shortfall
articles.desc: "Pistachio have been the game spoiler this year. The prices of pistachio from all origins including Iran, Afghanistan and California have increased," said Ravindra Mehta, member of central governing council at Nuts and Dry Fruits Council of India (NDFC-I). "The current pistachio crop in California is expected to be only about 40% of last year, which has led to an increase of 50% in pista prices in the wholesale markets and even more in retail," he added.

articles.title: Rs 9,000 crore land assets monetised so far in FY27
articles.desc: The NLMC, which is working under the aegis of the Department of Public Enterprises under the finance ministry, also has land assets worth another Rs 4,000-5,000 crore belonging to public sector undertakings (PSUs) in the pipeline. These are at various stages of processing, providing an additional pipeline of potential transactions.

articles.title: Polymarket unit gets US industry organization's approval to be futures broker
articles.desc: Polymarket has received approval from the National Futures Association for PM Derivatives LLC to act as a broker. This approval allows the company to expand its operations if it obtains further approval from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. The firm is actively under investigation by the CFTC regarding its marketing practices. Currently, Polymarket serves as a popular platform for betting on various events and elections.

articles.title: UK’s King Charles expresses ‘sorrow’ in Antigua over slave trade
articles.desc: Caribbean nations call for reparations as King Charles stops short of issuing an apology for colonial-era slavery.

articles.title: US midterms put Trump-era crypto boom and prediction markets at risk
articles.desc: The US midterm elections could threaten the crypto friendly regulatory environment created under President Donald Trump. A potential Democratic takeover of Congress may bring tighter oversight of digital assets and prediction markets, putting companies such as Coinbase, Strategy and Bullish under pressure as investors reassess the sector's regulatory outlook.

articles.title: South Carolina shrimpers weigh costs, vote in crucial US midterms
articles.desc: Shrimpers worry about fuel costs, tariffs and Trump's proposed cuts to the agency that provides vital weather data.

articles.title: CleanMax beats Q2 EBITDA estimates, reports strong H1 growth
articles.desc: CleanMax has surpassed analyst estimates for the third consecutive quarter, driven by portfolio expansion and strong business performance. The company reported a 58% rise in H1 EBITDA and a six-fold increase in profit after tax (PAT), highlighting its robust growth momentum and improving financial performance.

articles.title: Bagmane REIT declares Rs 527cr distribution to unitholders for September quarter
articles.desc: Bagmane Prime Office REIT announced a distribution of Rs 527 crore to unitholders for the September quarter. The company leased 1.2 million square feet during this period, achieving a committed occupancy rate of 99 percent. Most of the leasing activity was directed towards Global Capability Centres in Bengaluru, which highlights their preference for quality assets. The average rent achieved was slightly above the prevailing market rates, reflecting strong demand.

articles.title: Binance says North Korean hackers stole $6.34 billion funds in a technical breach
articles.desc: Binance reported a cyberattack attributed to North Korea that compromised $6.34 billion in digital assets. Approximately $2.85 billion of the affected assets have since been frozen or intercepted. The attackers utilized fake job interviews and advanced malware to breach Binance's security systems. Subsequently, the company took steps to replenish the lost assets and mitigate the damage caused.

articles.title: Sebi levies Rs 40 lakh penalty on four entities in Axis MF front-running case
articles.desc: Securities and Exchange Board of India has imposed a total penalty of Rs 40 lakh on four entities. This penalty includes fines on Woodstock Broking and Marfatia Stock Broking for front-running trades. The investigation spanned from April 1, 2021, to March 31, 2022, involving these entities. Evidence indicated that brokers facilitated these trades by providing necessary infrastructure and assistance.

articles.title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reports sixth consecutive quarterly loss
articles.desc: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank experienced a loss of Rs 70 crore in the second quarter, marking six consecutive quarters of decline. The lender’s operating profit was Rs 85 crore, but provisions of Rs 166 crore led to the net loss. Its gross non-performing asset ratio improved slightly, standing at 5.96% at the end of September. The bank's gross loan portfolio saw a year-on-year growth of 7.5%, reaching Rs 20,062 crore.

articles.title: Nexus Select Trust’s Q2 NOI rises 8% to Rs 504 cr, consumption up 13%
articles.desc: Nexus Select Trust reported an 8% year-on-year increase in net operating income for the second quarter. The company's retail assets experienced a 13% rise in consumption compared to the previous year. Nexus declared a distribution of Rs 359 crore, maintaining a 100% payout to unitholders for 13 consecutive quarters. The firm is expanding its portfolio with plans to develop a Grade-A mall and hotel in Guwahati.

articles.title: Loan growth, fall in provisions help SBI profits in Q2
articles.desc: State Bank of India reported a 14% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 23,038 crore, driven by 18% loan growth, higher net interest income, lower deposit costs and reduced loan loss provisions.

articles.title: Rising crude prices could push India's inflation by upto 1 percentage point, diversified imports helping secure oil supplies: EY's Gaurav Moda
articles.desc: Gaurav Moda, Partner and Energy Industry Leader at EY India said the increase in crude oil prices from an average of $60-65 per barrel to $90-95 has significantly raised India's energy import costs, even as the country continues to prioritise securing supplies amid geopolitical uncertainties.

articles.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
articles.desc: Indian equities rallied nearly 2%, with Sensex gaining 1,225 points and Nifty rising 370 points. Falling crude prices, renewed FII buying, resilient earnings and expectations of LTCG tax changes boosted sentiment, adding nearly Rs 4 lakh crore to market capitalisation.

articles.title: What's happening to UK interest rates and what does it mean for mortgages?
articles.desc: The interest rate set by the Bank of England affects mortgage, loan and savings rates for millions.

articles.title: MCX Q2 Results: Profit rockets 130% YoY to Rs 455 crore, revenue jumps 114%
articles.desc: Multi Commodity Exchange of India reported a 130% year-on-year jump in Q2FY26 consolidated net profit to Rs 454.57 crore, while revenue surged 114%. EBITDA rose 151%, margins expanded and shares touched a fresh 52-week high.

articles.title: Motilal Oswal Financial Services announces leadership rejig; appoints new heads across businesses
articles.desc: Motilal Oswal Financial Services announced major leadership changes across alternatives, retail broking and private wealth businesses. The reshuffle coincides with strong Q2 performance, with operating PAT rising 29% year-on-year to Rs 718 crore.

articles.title: RBI launches 3 surveys to capture inflation expectations, consumer confidence ahead of December policy meeting
articles.desc: Reserve Bank of India has announced the November 2026 round of the Inflation Expectations Survey of Households. This survey aims to capture households' perceptions regarding price movements and inflation based on their consumption patterns. Additionally, the Urban Consumer Confidence Survey seeks to understand household sentiments on the economic situation and employment. The Rural Consumer Confidence Survey collects perceptions from rural areas on economic conditions, income, and spending.

articles.title: US stocks today: Technology stocks lift S&P 500 as US midterm vote keeps investors on edge
articles.desc: US stocks rise as technology shares lead gains in the S&P 500 during the US midterm elections. Investors track the potential impact of the vote on markets while assessing concerns over artificial intelligence spending. Apple falls after a disappointing outlook, while Palantir declines and Fiserv rallies following its earnings beat.

articles.title: DuPont raises annual profit forecasts on strong healthcare, aerospace demand
articles.desc: DuPont has raised its full-year profit forecasts and projected fourth-quarter earnings exceed analyst estimates. The company experienced strong demand in healthcare, aerospace, and industrial water markets during the third quarter. DuPont's healthcare and water technologies segment reported nearly 4% growth year-over-year, reaching $865 million in net sales. Additionally, the company recently concluded a $250 million share repurchase program and plans to buy back an additional $250 million of shares.

articles.title: Ferrari nudges up full-year forecasts after beating consensus in Q3
articles.desc: Ferrari has revised its earnings outlook for 2026 due to impressive third-quarter performance that exceeded expectations. The company noted a 12% increase in adjusted EBITDA, greatly surpassing analyst forecasts. This growth stems from sales of high-margin vehicles and personalized customer requests. However, the total vehicle shipments dipped slightly, totaling 3,368 in the July-September timeframe. The robust order book extends through 2028, with more product launches on the horizon.

articles.title: Prediction markets face US midterms test as election bets soar
articles.desc: In the race towards the US midterm elections, over $1.48 billion has been wagered through prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket, highlighting their role in shaping political discourse. Experts raise alarms about the potential fallout if market outcomes deviate from real election results, which could undermine credibility. Notably, key Senate contests are intensifying market activity, indicating favorable odds for Democratic gains in Congress.

articles.title: Bata India Q2 Results: Profit rises 30% at Rs 18 crore, revenue rises to Rs 862 crore
articles.desc: Bata India Ltd achieved a 30.4% increase in net profit for the September quarter of FY27. Revenue from operations also rose by 7.54% to Rs 861.78 crore compared to the previous year. The company noted significant growth in profit after tax, driven by higher average selling prices. Bata India aims to maintain this growth momentum despite rising input costs and wage revisions. Shares of Bata India Ltd increased by 1.

articles.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
articles.desc: The move comes barely a week after Rwanda's defence ministry was hit with sanctions by the US Treasury.

articles.title: Apple’s robust India quarter; Giva’s $100 million funding
articles.desc: Apple posted record sales in India in the September quarter. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

articles.title: India bonds end tad higher on softer oil
articles.desc: Indian government bonds experienced a modest rise as the 10-year bond yield neared a one-month peak. Investor optimism was bolstered by decreasing oil prices, although caution was still prevalent ahead of the upcoming US midterm elections. The benchmark bond yield displayed its lowest point since early October after notable drops in earlier trading sessions.

articles.title: US stock futures mixed as Apple falls on margin warning, midterm results awaited
articles.desc: U.S. stock index futures reflect a mixed response as crude oil prices trend upwards ahead of midterm election outcomes. Apple's shares took a hit following its announcement regarding rising costs and potential holiday-quarter margin impacts. Despite Palantir Technologies exceeding revenue estimates, its stock plummeted post-results. Analysts are warning of heightened market volatility depending on elections and government expenditure.

articles.title: US Stock Market Highlights: Nasdaq rebounds as semiconductor stocks gain ahead of midterm results
Happiest Minds Q2 Results: Profit rises 15% to Rs 62 crore; revenue up 12% to Rs 645 crore
articles.desc: Happiest Minds Technologies has seen a 15.12% rise in consolidated net profit for the September quarter FY27. Revenue from operations also increased by 12.5% compared to the previous year. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 3.05 per equity share for the 2026-27 fiscal year. An exceptional charge was included in the quarter's results due to a proposed merger with ITC Infotech.

articles.title: Emcure Pharma Q2 Results: Profit jumps 29%  to Rs 325 crore
articles.desc: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd has posted a remarkable consolidated net profit of Rs 325.06 crore for the September quarter, reflecting substantial growth. Revenue surged from Rs 2,269.82 crore to Rs 2,820.47 crore during this period, with international operations increasing by 34 per cent. Additionally, domestic revenue witnessed an 11.1 per cent rise, as company leaders expressed confidence in sustaining this positive trend through the latter half of FY27.

articles.title: Nexus Select Trust Q2 net operating income rises 8 pc to Rs 504 cr
articles.desc: Nexus Select Trust has announced an 8% increase in its net operating income for the second quarter. The company reported a distribution of Rs 359 crore, reflecting growth in distribution per unit. Nexus Select Trust has cumulatively distributed over Rs 4,400 crore to its unitholders since its listing. The company marks its strategic entry into Northeast India with plans for a mall and hotel in Guwahati.

articles.title: V-Mart Retail Q2 loss widens to Rs 16 crore
articles.desc: V-Mart Retail reported a significant net loss of Rs 16.34 crore for the September quarter of FY27, a rise from Rs 8.87 crore reported in the same quarter of FY26. Revenue from operations saw an upward trend, increasing by 18 percent year-on-year to Rs 952.99 crore. However, total expenses surged by 22 percent, totaling Rs 976.37 crore. For the first half of FY27, total income reached Rs 2,047.

articles.title: UK meat industry hit by cyber-attack which targeted European supermarket freezers
articles.desc: Supermarkets in countries including Ireland, Sweden  and Belgium reported fridges being hiked in temperature on Monday.

articles.title: Minda Corp Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 68% to Rs 143 crore on strong revenue growth
articles.desc: Minda Corporation Ltd has reported a significant 68.2% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit for Q2. Revenue from operations also increased by 42.6% year-on-year, reaching Rs 2,189 crore. The company's Chairman highlighted continued progress in their growth strategy across key vehicle segments. Electric vehicle-related products contributed around 35% of new order wins during this quarter. Minda plans to enhance its product offerings and invest in R&D and manufacturing capabilities.

articles.title: NSE Q2 Results: Profit jumps 23% to Rs 2,578 crore, revenue rises 9%
articles.desc: NSE Q2 Results: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) reported a 23% year-on-year (YoY) increase in its consolidated profit after tax (PAT) to Rs 2,578 crore in the second quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with Rs 2,098 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year (Q2FY26).

articles.title: Indian Hotels Company among 6 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 16% in a month
articles.desc: Six BSE 200 stocks, including Bosch, Coforge, Divi's Laboratories, Eternal, Indian Hotels and Zydus Lifesciences, touched fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex rallied 1,225 points, reflecting renewed market momentum and buying interest.

articles.title: Wall Street's hidden bargains: 10 US largecap stocks trading at historic discount for investors
articles.desc: At least 10 US large-cap stocks trade at 47%-63% discounts to sector valuations, according to Vested Finance. Comcast leads the list, alongside AT&T, Fiserv and Bristol-Myers Squibb, amid market volatility and growing scrutiny of AI valuations.

articles.title: Market wrap:  BSE, Nestle India, Power Grid, SBI top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
articles.desc: Indian markets extended gains as the Sensex surged 1,225 points and Nifty climbed 370 points. Falling crude prices, softer US Treasury yields and FII buying boosted sentiment, with FMCG and realty stocks leading the broad-based rally.

articles.title: FPIs pour Rs 21,715 crore into Indian stocks in 10 days; is record sell-off finally reversing?
articles.desc: Foreign portfolio investors infused $2.29 billion into Indian equities over 10 days, signalling improving sentiment. Strong corporate earnings, attractive valuations and potential LTCG tax relief could revive foreign inflows, while crude oil prices remain a key risk.

articles.title: Drivers may get compensation offers before car finance saga ends
articles.desc: The regulator says it supports lenders offering early compensation offers, as long as they are fair.

articles.title: European shares fall as tech stocks slide, Middle East tensions weigh
articles.desc: European shares declined as technology stocks led losses amid concerns over AI valuations and escalating US-Iran tensions. Rising oil prices added pressure, while stronger earnings expectations lifted healthcare stocks, with Bayer gaining 6% after raising its 2026 profit outlook.

articles.title: Samsung to make AMD, Nvidia chip parts at second Texas plant: Report
articles.desc: Construction is due to start formally this month, with the plant having secured orders for its entire output, and most of the secured volume is for AMD, according to Maeil.

articles.title: China's 'Lipstick King' touts AI tokens in first for Singles' Day festival
articles.desc: The launch is the first time AI token packages have been offered as a significant consumer product category during Singles' Day, the world's largest shopping festival originally held on November 11 each year.

articles.title: 'Quiet quitting' could be hitting the economy - here's why
articles.desc: Britons have become less engaged with the jobs they do and are less willing to put in extra effort, a report has found.

articles.title: R&D-focused stocks deliver over 23% annualised returns in five years, outperform NSE 500: Monarch AIF
articles.desc: Indian companies increasing R&D spending outperformed the NSE 500 TRI over five years, delivering 23.5% average annualised returns. Businesses combining strong research growth with higher R&D intensity achieved 32.5%, highlighting innovation's growing importance for investors.

articles.title: Knowledge Realty Trust NOI up 15%, declares record Rs 764 cr distribution in Q2
articles.desc: Knowledge Realty Trust reported 15% year-on-year NOI growth to Rs 1,140.4 crore in Q2 FY27, alongside 13% revenue growth. Record distributions reached Rs 764 crore, supported by strong leasing, occupancy and rental growth.

articles.title: India may reimpose broken rice export restrictions as prices cross $360 per tonne: IREF
articles.desc: India may reimpose restrictions on exports of 100% broken rice as international prices cross $360 per tonne and domestic demand from ethanol manufacturers and poultry-feed producers increases, the Indian Rice Exporters' Federation (IREF) has warned. No fresh curbs have been announced so far.

articles.title: India eases forex reporting rules for small value service exports, imports
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India has eased foreign exchange reporting rules for services exports and imports, reducing compliance requirements for resident individuals and setting a ₹1 million threshold for certain transactions. Resident individuals exporting services will be deemed to have filed export declarations after submitting payment details to banks, while reporting obligations for larger transactions and non-individual entities will continue.

articles.title: Emcure Pharma shares jump 7% after Q2 profit rises 29% YoY to Rs 325 crore
articles.desc: Emcure Pharmaceuticals shares rose up to 7.3% after the company reported a 29.3% year-on-year increase in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 325.1 crore. Revenue grew 24.3%, while EBITDA rose 30.9%, supported by strong international business growth.

articles.title: Rupee nudges higher, forward premiums dip with focus on US midterm, oil moves
articles.desc: On Tuesday, the Indian rupee gained slightly against the dollar, closing at 94.74 per dollar. This change occurred as investors awaited the results of the US midterm elections and developments in the Iran war. Oil prices rebounded, raising concerns about potential impacts on energy supplies. Analysts suggest that potential outcomes from the elections could influence the dollar's short-term position.

articles.title: Is the AI boom losing steam? Global economy faces growing risks
articles.desc: Global financial markets face mounting pressure from geopolitical conflicts, rising government debt and trade tensions, raising concerns about the resilience of the global economy. While the AI investment boom has driven stock markets to record highs and supported growth expectations, rising borrowing costs, inflation, weakening currencies and the prolonged Iran war threaten to undermine investor confidence and expose deeper vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Bonus issue alert! Choice International to reward shareholders with 1:1 bonus shares. Check details
articles.desc: Choice International has approved a 1:1 bonus issue, its first such corporate action in two years. Under the proposal, shareholders will receive one bonus share for every share held on the record date, which will be announced later. The move will double the number of outstanding shares without changing the company’s market capitalisation, while potentially improving stock liquidity and affordability.

articles.title: MFs cut stakes in 8 smallcap stocks after two quarters of buying; shares tumble up to 30% in 3 months
articles.desc: Mutual funds reduced their holdings in 79 BSE small-cap stocks during the September 2026 quarter, reversing two quarters of accumulation. Several affected stocks fell sharply, with major laggards declining between 24% and 32% over three months.

articles.title: German bond yields rise as oil climbs ahead of US Midterm elections
articles.desc: German government bond yields rose as rebounding oil prices and caution ahead of the US midterm elections weighed on sentiment. The 10-year Bund yield climbed further from a two-month low, while investors assessed ECB rate expectations and global risk appetite.

articles.title: Oracle plans to raise $20 billion through bonds and stock sales
articles.desc: The company said last week that it expects capital spending to peak this fiscal year and the next as it builds more cloud-computing capacity, but pledged to raise no more than $20 billion in additional financing for AI through fiscal 2030.

articles.title: BLS E-Services Q2 Results: Net profit rises 12% YoY pc to Rs 20.5 cr
articles.desc: BLS E-Services reported a 12.4 percent year-on-year increase in profit after tax for Q2 FY27. The total income for the quarter reached Rs 428.1 crore, up 55.1 percent year-on-year. Additionally, the company's operating EBITDA rose to Rs 28.8 crore, marking a 43.8 percent increase from the previous year. The Business Correspondent segment also achieved a Gross Transaction Value of over Rs 41,400 crore.

articles.title: SBI Q2 Results: Standalone profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 23,038 crore, NII jumps 15%
articles.desc: SBI Q2 Results: Net interest income in the reporting period increased 15% YoY to Rs 49,143 crore.

articles.title: Bayer raises 2026 profit outlook on strong pharmaceuticals performance
articles.desc: Bayer raised its 2026 profit outlook after its pharmaceuticals division delivered stronger-than-expected third-quarter sales. The German group also lowered its debt forecast, signalling improving growth momentum and a stronger financial position.

articles.title: US Treasury projects $618 billion borrowing in Q4, $800 billion in Q1 2027
articles.desc: The US Treasury is estimating federal borrowing will hit $618 billion in the last quarter of 2026, which is $10 billion less than previously thought. Despite anticipating lower cash flows, the Treasury projects borrowing of $800 billion in early 2027 as well. Market watchers are eager for upcoming announcements regarding Treasury auctions, as these might indicate changes in their bond issuance tactics.

articles.title: NSE International Exchange begins 23.5-hour trading, extends market access across global time zones
articles.desc: NSE International Exchange has introduced a 23.5-hour trading schedule, providing near-continuous market access across Asian, European and American time zones. The extended window aims to help global investors respond to international developments while strengthening GIFT City’s position as a global financial hub.

articles.title: India has never allowed genetically modified products' import, won't do in future: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India continues to maintain a strict policy against the import of genetically modified products, as stated by Minister Piyush Goyal. He highlighted that the dairy sector remains particularly sensitive and has not been opened in trade agreements. Goyal emphasized India's commitment to protecting its agricultural and fisheries sectors while seeking preferential market access for textiles and pharmaceuticals.

articles.title: Binance co-CEO says company is in very strong financial health after $6.3 billion heist
articles.desc: Teng told a Hong Kong Fintech Week event Binance's hourly inflows and outflows had "pretty much normalised" and 95% of the affected tokens had been replenished.

articles.title: GRSE shares jump 9% after signing Rs 32,000 crore Indian Navy contract for five next-generation corvettes
articles.desc: GRSE shares surged nearly 9% after securing a Rs 32,000-crore Indian Navy contract to build five Next Generation Corvettes. The nine-year project will strengthen indigenous defence manufacturing, enhance maritime capabilities and reinforce GRSE's warship-building position, adding significantly to its order book and long-term business prospects.

articles.title: 4 reasons why Reliance Industries shares can rally after Monday magic sparked historic 12% surge
articles.desc: Reliance Industries shares surged, their biggest single-day gain since April 2020, adding nearly Rs 2 lakh crore to the company's market capitalisation after strong Q2 results. Despite remaining down over 17% in 2026, analysts see further upside potential, citing positive fundamental and technical cues.

articles.title: Bajaj Finserv Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 23% YoY to Rs 2,758 crore, shares rise 2%
articles.desc: Bajaj Finserv Q2 Results: The firm’s revenue from operations, meanwhile, increased around 17% YoY to Rs 43,416 crore during the second quarter of FY27, from Rs 37,215 crore reported in the year-ago period.

articles.title: India to make tunnel boring machines at home if China curbs exports: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India is gearing up to start producing its own tunnel boring machines if China decides to limit its exports. This statement came from Piyush Goyal, India's trade minister, after Beijing made its recent announcement. It highlights India’s plan to not rely on foreign supplies and enhance its domestic manufacturing capabilities in this crucial area.

articles.title: No water to sow, no respite at the grocery store: India's prolonged food inflation worry
articles.desc: Indian farmers face challenges in sowing winter crops amid dwindling water supplies from a weak monsoon. Amarsingh Gushinge's village experiences a significant rainfall deficit, impacting crop planting decisions. Food inflation could worsen as key staples see rising prices, aggravating the economic strain on households. The Reserve Bank of India may respond with interest rate hikes to combat rising inflationary pressures.

articles.title: Global markets were already fragile. Big AI bets could break them
articles.desc: Investors flocked to bonds. Yields, which move inversely to price, fell from multidecade highs, with the benchmark 10-year Treasury, which guides borrowing costs globally, falling almost 20 basis points on October 22, its biggest daily fall since early 2023.

articles.title: Reddit blasts Australia's 'inept' social media ban as court challenge begins
articles.desc: Australia's world-first teen social media ban was "ill thought out" and amounted to a "profound restriction on political debate", a lawyer for messaging platform Reddit told the country's top court in the first legal challenge to the law.

articles.title: From SBI to Binance, how financial institutions are becoming cyberattack targets
articles.desc: Recent incidents involving cryptocurrency exchange Binance and Indian public sector lender State Bank of India (SBI) have once again put the spotlight on the issue. While Binance reported a security breach involving unauthorised cryptocurrency withdrawals estimated at around $6.3 billion, SBI is investigating a suspected data leak involving nearly 3,900 customer records.

articles.title: Singapore's Grab lifts 2026 forecasts on strong ride-hailing, delivery demand
articles.desc: Singapore's Grab lifted its annual forecasts on Tuesday, helped by steady growth in its ride-hailing unit, while demand for its delivery services benefited from promotional offers and expansion into categories beyond groceries.

articles.title: India will become the world’s largest economy by end of the century, predicts top economist Jeffrey D Sachs
articles.desc: Renowned economist Jeffrey D Sachs said India could become the world’s largest economy by the end of the century, with a population twice that of China. Speaking at the World Symposium on "Ancient Wisdom for Modern Challenges" in Varanasi, he said the world was moving towards a multipolar order where no single country or region would dominate.

articles.title: Blackstone president says more tech sector fundraising ahead to keep up with AI industry growth
articles.desc: Blackstone President Jon Gray said on Tuesday there would be more global equity fundraising needed to keep up with the enormous likely demand from the AI industry's growth.

articles.title: Anthropic says revenue surged 1,100% ahead of IPO
articles.desc: Anthropic, one of the world's leading artificial intelligence companies, on Monday reported a more than 1,100 percent surge in quarterly revenue and nearly $900 billion in spending commitments as it counts down to its Wall Street listing later this month. The filing said the company has committed to spend about $895 billion, mostly on computing power, with $70 billion of that due before September 2027.

articles.title: Binance to reopen withdrawals for more assets on several networks
articles.desc: Binance said on Monday it will reopen withdrawals for more assets on networks, including BSC, ETH, SOL, XRP and SUI. The reopenings will begin at 04:00 GMT on Tuesday, the company added.

articles.title: Apple beats sales and profit expectations but AI costs weigh on holiday sales
articles.desc: Apple exceeded analysts' expectations for its latest results on Monday when the iPhone-maker said it notched a "revenue record" for the July-September quarter, driven by iPhone sales and services revenue, but increased costs related to AI will drag down margins.  This includes primarily the impact of higher memory costs, as well as some costs related to the ramp of Siri AI," Parekh said.

articles.title: OpenAI’s India user base doubles; Rapido GOV quadruples
articles.desc: Happy Tuesday! India has become ChatGPT’s largest market globally, with its user base doubling. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

articles.title: We will consider the call for review of LTCG tax: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman
articles.desc: "The circumstances have changed and, therefore, the voices of concern are louder,'' she said at a media event, in reference to reports that her administration has received suggestions to review levies on long-term capital gains (LTCG) for overseas investors. "I quite appreciate that. So, I'll consider all this... Our growth is very important, where people are putting their very best, we are able to see sustained 7(%)-plus growth.''
